sections.title: Customer Registration & Onboarding
sections.summary: Create an organization registration, provide company and contact details, upload required documents, define delivery locations, nominate the Customer Administrator, and submit the application for Sales review.
steps: Open the customer registration page and start a new application.
Enter the required company and contact information.
Upload the required company documents and provide valid future expiry dates.
Add delivery locations and select map locations where applicable.
Review the application and submit it for Sales review.

sections.title: Sales Representative
sections.summary: Review submitted customer registration information, approve the registration, and activate the customer account using the authorized Sales workflow.
steps: Open the submitted application from the Sales applications queue.
Review the company, contact, document, delivery-location, and administrator information.
For an approved application, complete customer account activation using the existing activation action.

uatCases.title: Start a customer registration
uatCases.preconditions: The registration page is available and the user is not signed in.
uatCases.expectedResult: The registration workflow opens and allows the user to enter company information.

uatCases.title: Complete company and contact information
uatCases.preconditions: A customer registration has been started.
uatCases.expectedResult: Valid company and contact information is retained and the registration can continue.

uatCases.title: Upload registration documents
uatCases.preconditions: The registration has reached the document step and valid files are available.
steps: Enter valid future expiry dates where required.
uatCases.expectedResult: The uploaded documents and their metadata remain associated with the registration.

uatCases.title: Add a delivery location and map position
uatCases.preconditions: The registration has reached the delivery-location step.
steps: Select and confirm the correct map location.
uatCases.expectedResult: The delivery location and selected map position are retained in the registration.

uatCases.title: Nominate administrator and submit registration
uatCases.preconditions: All preceding registration steps contain valid information.
uatCases.expectedResult: The application is submitted for Sales review and receives an application reference.

uatCases.title: Review and approve a customer registration
uatCases.preconditions: A valid customer registration is pending Sales review and the Sales user is authenticated.
steps: Open the pending registration from the Sales applications queue.
Review the submitted information and documents.
uatCases.expectedResult: The application is approved through the authorized Sales workflow.

uatCases.title: Activate an approved customer account
uatCases.preconditions: The customer application is approved and ready for account activation.
steps: Run the customer account activation action.
uatCases.expectedResult: The customer account is activated using the approved registration information.

uatCases.title: Check application status
uatCases.preconditions: The user has the submitted application reference and registered email.
steps: Enter the application reference and registered email.
uatCases.expectedResult: The current customer-visible application result is displayed.
